the parish office is open in the presbytery, 9.30am-1.00pm wednesday & thursday mornings ( closed on holy days ) for all bookings of masses, baptisms and weddings. mass cards also available.

baptisms: 2nd & 4th saturdays of the month. confessions available on request before mass. love god, love your neighbour. we don’t love in order to get to heaven; we love because heaven is already ours in christ. we don’t love in order to win god’s favour; we love because we already have god’s favour in christ. we don’t love so that god will love us; we love because god has loved us in christ with the greatest love we will ever know, the crucified love of jesus. jesus came to make us more loving. what form this loving take is not important, but what is important is that it does take place. ~ fr gerard. for emergencies only please ‘phone: during the week fr gerard finucane (087) 0554874 fr jerry keane (087) 2844649 fr pat (087) 2200114 from 1pm sunday –9am monday this weekend only fr gearoid walsh (087) 6759263 november offerings for our beloved dead are due before the 1st of november. leaflets for the lists of your dead are available at the exits of the church. use the blue topped november offerings envelope in your box. masses as announced in parish newsletter during november will be offered for all whose names are on the parish november dead list.

come & join our parish choir! as we prepare for christmas & the very special celebration of 200 years of st marys church ballyheigue in 2027, we warmly invite new members to join our choir. all voices are welcome whether you have sung in a choir before or simply enjoy singing come along and help make these celebrations truly memorable through music & song! put your name down at the parish office, the sacristy or to any of the priests. tralee branch of the red cross would like to thank everyone who contributed to their church gate collection, they gratefully collected €440

ireland's 3rd national first saturdays conference this year's conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. more information and the list of buses going are available on

. at fatima our lady promised that if we did what she asked there would be peace in the world and that many souls would be saved. 200th anniversary of st marys church committee will hold a fundraising church gate collection on 31st of october & 1st november, please support if you can. thank you! next meeting is 29th october 2026 at 7:45pm in the community centre

mass for the deceased of the past year, on thursday the 19th of november 7pm, we will remember in a special way all our faithful departed who have gone to their eternal rest during the last year. relatives and friends are warmly invited to attend this memorial mass during which a candle will be lit for each of the departed and their names will be remembered in prayer. you are welcome to then take the candle home. if you would like to remember someone who died outside the parish since last november, please drop their names in the letterbox of the presbytery.

you, your families and loved ones are invited to the annual november mass for all those who have died within the hospital over the past year, including those who have died in palliative care services, maternity services, the relatives of hospital staff, and former staff members of university hospital kerry. the mass for the dead will be celebrated on monday 2nd november 7pm in st john’s church, castle street, tralee. the mass will also be live streamed for those unable to attend in person on
